name: Spooky Shopping Tour!
source:
Spooky Shopping Tour is a visual novel, where the end goal is to customize your shop! Get to know the characters and try appealing to their tastes in order to obtain their ending!

[From [url=https://kathinkapng.itch.io/spooky-shopping-trip]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Spooky Shopping Tour!》是一部以装扮自己的商店为最终目标的视觉小说！认识各位角色，试着投其所好，就能达成各自的结局！

［摘自[url=https://kathinkapng.itch.io/spooky-shopping-trip]itch.io[/url]］
